definition.name: 完播率
definition.definition: 播放开始中有完成事件的播放次数比例。
definition.numerator: content_events 中有 complete 的去重 play_id 数
definition.denominator: 有 start 的去重 play_id 数；为零则不可计算
definition.joins: content_events.session_id = sessions.session_id；sessions.user_id = users.user_id；start/complete 按 play_id 关联
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai；播放开始日在 [start,end)；content_events/sessions 水位完整；不能把缺失当零
definition.pitfalls: 重复上报去重；重复观看新 play_id；完成事件缺失影响观测，独立 playback_telemetry 可交叉核对，不能仅凭差异证明采集故障

parameters.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT play_id, MIN(session_id) AS sid, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS began,
      MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event,MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS start_times,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
      SUM(CASE WHEN session_id IS NULL OR play_id IS NULL OR occurred_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
      FROM content_events GROUP BY play_id)
      SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,s.os AS actual_os,s.version AS actual_version,
      MAX(e.last_event) AS last_event,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starts,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NOT NULL THEN e.completed ELSE 0 END) AS observed_completed,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NULL OR e.sessions<>1 OR e.invalid>0 OR e.start_times<>1 OR e.first_event<e.began OR s.session_id IS NULL OR s.os IS NULL OR s.version IS NULL OR s.started_at IS NULL OR s.started_at>e.began THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_alignment
      FROM e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON e.sid=s.session_id WHERE CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01' AND CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15'
      GROUP BY period,s.os,s.version ORDER BY period,s.os,s.version

WITH e AS (SELECT play_id, MIN(session_id) AS sid, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS began,
      MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event,MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS start_times,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
      SUM(CASE WHEN session_id IS NULL OR play_id IS NULL OR occurred_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid

parameters.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.registration_os,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period,registration_os,COUNT(*) AS users,SUM(retained) AS retained,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os

parameters.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
        SELECT u.registration_os,
          CASE WHEN CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id
            AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)=CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)+1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
        FROM users u WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01'
          AND CAST(u.registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
        SELECT period,registration_os,COUNT(*) AS users,SUM(retained) AS retained,
          SUM(retained)*1.0/COUNT(*) AS retention_rate,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-01' ELSE '2026-01-08' END AS window_start,
          CASE WHEN period='previous' THEN '2026-01-08' ELSE '2026-01-15' END AS window_end
        FROM cohort GROUP BY period,registration_os ORDER BY period,registration_os
